name: How do general contractors charge for their services?
description: General contractors typically charge a fixed price, cost-plus, or time and materials.

mainEntity.name: How do general contractors charge for their services?

acceptedAnswer.text: General contractors typically charge in a few ways: a fixed-price contract, where you pay a predetermined amount for the entire project; a cost-plus contract, where you pay for materials and labor plus a percentage or fixed fee for the contractor's services; or a time and materials contract, where you pay for the actual cost of labor and materials, often with an agreed-upon hourly rate. The method depends on the project's scope and complexity.
acceptedAnswer.description: General contractors typically charge a fixed price, cost-plus, or time and materials.
